findings.summary: End-to-end CLI wall-clock is not capped at ~10s when git stalls: pre-existing module-load `git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD` in src/cli/agent-version.ts (untouched by this slice, imported via sync.ts) has no timeout and ran before the replay deadline scope (observed 30s linger; refusal still correct at ~38.7s with no mutation).
findings.recommendation: follow-up: timeout or lazify the agent-version module-load git probe

findings.summary: Deadline cannot preempt an individual wedged synchronous filesystem syscall, and Node's synchronous-spawn timeout waits for a SIGTERM-ignoring/deferring child to exit (observed blocked past 23s outer guard; ordinary stalled children die at ~8s). No universal 10s end-to-end wall-clock cap is claimed.

executeBoundedReplay's default merge target is the real ~/.tokenizer/queue.jsonl; isolated tests must inject mergeEvents (suite does). One evaluator probe iteration wrote one synthetic row to the real queue; verified sole line and deleted immediately. Not a product defect.
